4 المظهُ He put the water upon the edge of his lips, (M,) or upon his lips, or lip. (K, accord. to different copies.) ―
-b2- And hence إِلْمَاظٌ is used to signify (tropical:) The act of piercing, or thrusting, feebly [with a spear or the like]. (M, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
